sources.title: Environmental accounts
facts: Topic page links current environmental-account publications and datasets.
Environmental accounts combine economic and environmental measures under defined accounting bases.
Topic metadata is not parcel-level measurement.

sources.title: UK Environmental Accounts: 2026 release
facts: Release provides accredited environmental-account datasets for 1990 to 2024.
Energy and atmospheric-emissions datasets have separate definitions and revision histories.
Release-level statistics are not parcel observations.

sources.title: UK Environmental Accounts: 2026 bulletin
facts: 2024 UK residence-basis greenhouse-gas emissions are estimated at 478 MtCO2e.
Residence basis includes UK residents and registered businesses wherever activity occurs.
Residence-basis estimates must not be conflated with territorial estimates.

sources.title: Measuring UK greenhouse gas emissions
facts: Methodology distinguishes territorial, residence or production, and footprint or consumption measures.
2025 territorial and 2024 residence estimates use different accounting boundaries and reference periods.
Accounting bases cannot be mixed without explicit transformation evidence.

sources.title: Environment, climate and nature insights, UK: 2026
facts: ONS posted corrections on 24 July 2026 including an enclosed-farmland correction and removal of unreliable climate-related mortality estimates.
Superseded statements must not be reused as current evidence.
Correction metadata is a chronology guard, not parcel emissions data.

sources.title: Atmospheric emissions: greenhouse gases by industry and gas — provisional
facts: Dataset covers greenhouse gases by industry and gas to 2024.
Provisional edition provides top-level estimates and remains distinct from the current all-sector edition.
A prior correction to 2023 carbon dioxide values is recorded in the revision history.

sources.title: Atmospheric emissions: bridging tables
facts: Bridging tables relate UK Environmental Accounts measures to UNFCCC and UNECE measures for 1990 to 2024.
Bridging data explain accounting differences rather than create parcel values.
Revision history must be retained.

sources.title: Energy use: total
facts: Dataset reports direct and reallocated UK energy use by industry to 2024.
Energy use is activity data, not itself a greenhouse-gas measurement.
Planned revisions and corrections are distinguished in ONS metadata.

sources.title: Energy use: by industry, source and fuel
facts: Dataset disaggregates energy use by industry, source and fuel for 1990 to 2024.
Fuel and source classifications must be preserved during reuse.
No emissions conversion is valid without an explicit supported method and activity input.

sources.title: Energy use: bridging table
facts: Dataset bridges UK Environmental Accounts energy use with DUKES for 1990 to 2024.
Bridge relationships do not imply identical accounting scopes.
Dataset is not parcel-bound.

sources.title: Energy use: by industry reallocated to final consumer and energy intensity
facts: Current edition includes scheduled revisions and a documented correction history.
Energy intensity is usage per unit of economic output, not direct emissions.
Superseded values must not be silently reused.

sources.title: Statistics at DfT
facts: Latest listed releases include SAF and RTFO fifth provisional statistics on 23 July 2026.
Vehicle licensing January to March 2026 was published 15 July 2026.
Transport and environment statistics 2024 was published 14 July 2026.

sources.title: Transport and environment statistics: 2024
facts: Domestic transport emitted 110.4 MtCO2e in 2024 according to the release.
Domestic transport represented 30 percent of UK domestic greenhouse-gas emissions in 2024.
National transport statistics must not be assigned to individual parcels.

sources.title: Transport energy and environment statistics collection
facts: Collection was updated with Transport and environment statistics 2024.
Collection combines multiple transport-environment statistical products with their own definitions.
Collection metadata does not itself create a measured emissions value.

sources.title: Vehicle licensing statistics: January to March 2026
facts: Release reports 769,000 first registrations in 2026 Q1 and 150,000 first-registered zero-emission vehicles.
At end-March 2026 the UK had 42.4 million licensed vehicles and 2.148 million licensed zero-emission vehicles.
Vehicle stock and registrations are activity or stock measures, not direct emissions measurements.

sources.title: Vehicle licensing statistics data tables
facts: Data tables were updated for January to March 2026 vehicle licensing statistics.
Vehicle licensing tables retain geography and vehicle-definition constraints.
Licensing tables cannot be converted to parcel emissions without a supported method.

sources.title: Sustainable Aviation Fuel Mandate statistics collection
facts: Collection identifies the fifth provisional 2025 release as latest on 23 July 2026.
Provisional reports remain subject to change until the final publication.
Mandate supply and certificates are not parcel emissions measurements.

sources.title: SAF Mandate statistics 2025: Fifth provisional release
facts: Release is based on data available as of 8 July 2026 and is explicitly incomplete.
Finalised 2025 data are scheduled for November 2026.
Provisional status must be preserved.

sources.title: SAF Mandate statistics data tables
facts: Fifth provisional 2025 tables are incomplete and based on data available 8 July 2026.
Tables include fuel volumes, certificates, trades and carbon or sustainability characteristics.
Certificate or fuel-supply records are not direct parcel emissions measurements.

sources.title: Renewable Transport Fuel Obligation statistics collection
facts: Collection lists RTFO 2025 fifth provisional statistics on 23 July 2026.
Provisional tables remain subject to change before finalisation.
Compliance and renewable-fuel supply data must remain distinct from parcel emissions.

sources.title: BUS monthly scheme update
facts: Figures cover scheme activity through 30 June 2026.
Applications, vouchers, redemptions, grants and budget are scheme-administration measures.
Scheme uptake is not measured greenhouse-gas abatement at parcel level.

sources.title: Boiler Upgrade Scheme guidance for installers
facts: Version 5.1 is current for relevant applications properly made on or after 28 April 2026.
Updated uplifted grant guidance applies to eligible off-gas-grid properties from 21 July 2026.
Eligibility and grant guidance are not emissions observations.

sources.title: Boiler Upgrade Scheme guidance for property owners
facts: Version 5.1 is current and includes guidance for uplifted grant values from 21 July 2026.
Application status and eligibility are administrative facts.
Guidance does not establish parcel greenhouse-gas savings.

sources.title: Boiler Upgrade Scheme Product Eligibility List
facts: Product Eligibility List was updated 23 July 2026.
Listing does not guarantee compliance with all BUS eligibility requirements.
Product eligibility is not parcel emissions evidence.

sources.title: Greenhouse gas reporting: conversion factors 2026
facts: Factors support calculation and reporting of greenhouse-gas emissions from UK activities in 2026.
Activity-based factors differ from Defra spend-based multipliers.
Factors are calculation tools, not direct measurements.

sources.title: Conversion factors 2026 Code statement
facts: Statement documents trustworthiness, quality and value controls for the conversion-factor product.
Quality assurance does not change factor-versus-measurement semantics.
Method version must remain attached to any factor use.

sources.title: UK ETS technical guidance and tools
facts: Collection includes 2026 country-specific carbon emission factors published 24 July 2026.
Factors support monitoring and reporting under specified UK ETS circumstances.
Reporting factors are not direct parcel measurements.

sources.title: Participating in the UK ETS
facts: Guidance describes permitting, monitoring, reporting, verification and registry obligations.
Domestic maritime emissions entered UK ETS scope from 1 July 2026 under the described rules.
Scheme obligations and allowance surrender are not parcel measurements.

sources.title: UK local authority and regional greenhouse gas emissions statistics, 2005 to 2024
facts: Publication provides accredited local-authority and regional greenhouse-gas estimates for 2005 to 2024.
Web-accessible statistical and technical reports were added 30 June 2026.
Local-authority aggregates are not individual parcel measurements.

sources.title: Carbon footprint for the UK and England to 2023
facts: 2023 UK consumption-based footprint is estimated at 699 MtCO2e and England at 587 MtCO2e.
Publication records corrections on 7 July and 24 July 2026 and a methodology update for the 2026 edition.
Consumption-basis estimates must remain distinct from territorial and residence measures and cannot be assigned to parcels.
